result.reason: The clause appropriately converts the no-hire into a mutual non-solicit, limits it to directly involved personnel, and includes the required general-recruitment and unsolicited-approach carve-outs. However, the restriction applies “during the term” as well as for 12 months after an individual’s involvement ends. If involvement ends before the Agreement terminates, this could extend the restriction beyond 12 months from that individual’s involvement, contrary to the fallback. It should instead apply during the individual’s involvement and for 12 months thereafter.
